card.name: Amounts and durations before frequency
card.fires_on: Fires on the unit or noun that finishes a quantity, such as mg, minutes or physical activity, right before a frequency like twice daily or five days a week. Also fires on a few words in a phonetics description of stops.

modes.label: Dose or exercise amount
modes.description: The measure word that ends a dose or time amount, just before how often it is taken or done.
modes.example: The recommended starting and treatment dose of asenapine sublingual tablets is 5 mg to 10<< mg>> twice daily.
